messages:
alex_k: rolling out the compat toggles for structured output/function-calling today. plan: 10% canary on hosted API, SDKs remain opt-in until we bump clients. Qs?

maria_s: per-route or per-org? we need per-route for async backends that can't handle funcs.

samir: per-route + org override sounds good. runtime toggle will check route-level flag, then org, then global.

jing_w: SDK plan: js/python will expose new option `structured_output` with values 'off'|'compat'|'strict'. default 'off' until we ship 1.5.

alex_k: canary audience: internal orgs + orgs with tag `beta=true`. enabling via ff service key `ff/so_rollout_v1`. start at 10% traffic, step to 25% after OK.

maria_s: telemetry needs: add `so_canary=true` tag on spans and log `so.mismatch` when structured vs legacy outputs differ. also perf hist for latency.

samir: i'll add the metric `so.regression_rate` and dashboard. PR for telemetry: #4388.

jing_w: adding client shim to emit `x-so-mode` header when `compat` used. snippet:
```
// JS SDK
client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1',
  structured_output: 'compat',
})
```

default behavior: if server-side compat flag is off, client must not request structured path unless explicitly forced.

alex_k: guardrail: if function calling errors or schema mismatch > 1% across sample, auto-disable canary and alert oncall. fallback: route to legacy text generator and set header `x-so-fallback: true`.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging at 2024-11-06T12:30Z, prod canary at 2024-11-06T15:00Z unless blocked. build: `ff/so-rollout_v1` target 10%.

maria_s: code review ping @samir @jing_w for PRs 4321, 4388. please ack and add changelog blurb.

samir: acked, will add test harness for mixed payloads and run overnight.

alex_k: good. i'll own the rollout steps and coord with support. post any postmortem notes in #incidents if anything odd.

jing_w: one more: need migration note for private deployments — admin UI will expose toggle; ops must run DB migration v12 to add `so_flags` table.

maria_s: noted, i'll draft the support KB and include rollback steps (flip ff/so_rollout_v1 to 0%). :thumbsup:

alex_k: thanks all — will post final rollout timeline in ~30m.
